text.en:
Barangay Pandanon and Barangay Igmayaan in the Municipality of Murcia and portions of
Barangay Lalong and Barangay Marcelo in the Municipality of Calatrava, all in the Province of Negros
Occidental, and Barangay Bunga and Barangay Kumaliskis and a portion of Barangay Prosperidad, all in the
City of San Carlos, are separated from their respective municipalities and city and constituted into a distinct
and independent municipality in the Province of Negros Occidental to be known as the Municipality of
Salvador Benedicto.

The boundaries of the new municipality shall be as follows:
"Beginning from corner No. 1, being a point at the junction of Bago River and Pandanon River; thence
following Pandanon River upstream in a northeasterly direction about 4,550 meters to corner No. 2, being a
point at the junction of Pandanon River and a creek; thence N 68° 30’ E about 1,505 meters to corner No. 3,
being a point at peak of Mt. Mandalagan; thence S 87 40’ E about 3,020 meters to corner No. 4, being a point
on top of a ridge; thence S 60° 25’ E about 1,800 meters to corner No. 5, being a point on side of the former
ILCO logging road; thence S 3° 30’ W about 1,445 meters to corner No. 6, being a point on top of a mountain
ridge; thence S 53° 00’ W about 2,930 meters, being a point at the junction of Bago River and Pinawayan
Creek; thence following Bago River downstream in a south and north-westerly direction about 7,180 meters to
corner No. 1, a point in the beginning, whose tie line is identical to corner No. 1, a point at the junction of
